Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly instructed opening and comparing authoritative sources (e.g., SFdb, IMDb, Wikipedia), WebSurfer only repeated a search and relied on DuckDuckGo snippets instead of opening the sources. This failure to follow instructions and verify with primary pages introduced/confused conflicting snippets (Helsingborg vs. Helsingfors) and led to repeated, unproductive queries rather than resolving the discrepancy promptly.
